questions.q: Waqf hunt (pupil PDF): find every waqf sign in Al-Qiyamah on the mushaf page and write its meaning. Today's rota group recites 75:20 to 40.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher sheet; the saktah at 75:27 marked.

questions.q: Extend: name two other places of saktah in Hafs.
Stretch: what would happen to the sound of 75:27 without the saktah?
questions.a: The noon of مَنْ would merge into raa (idgham): marraaq.
A) pause briefly without a breath. Saktah: a brief silent pause, no breath.
a silent pause with no breath
options: a silent pause with no breath

questions.q: Think again: Hafs recites a saktah in only a few places in the Qur'an, one of them in Al-Qiyamah. Why might a tiny pause matter so much?
questions.a: It keeps two words apart so the meaning is clear: مَنْ and رَاقٍۢ stay separate.
